demo.program:
# John F. Kennedy — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("When and where was John F. Kennedy?", "1961-1963, 35th"),
    ("What is John F. Kennedy known for?", "Cuban Missile Crisis"),
    ("What is when/where?", "1961-1963, 35th"),
    ("What is what happened?", "Cuban Missile Crisis"),
    ("What is significance?", "Assassinated in Dallas"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
